content_blocks.content: The narrative of Chapter 12 centres on The Night Massacre. The characters face choices that test the boundaries of Moksha — the cosmic order that governs all actions.

content_blocks.english_translation: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to its fruits.
content_blocks.content: This verse defines selfless action — the bedrock of the Gita's teaching.
Moksha as explored in The Night Massacre reveals that true freedom lies in detachment from outcome while remaining fully committed to righteous action.
By the end of Chapter 12, the reader understands that the battlefield of Kurukshetra is also the battlefield of the human mind — where every soul must choose between ego and truth.
